# Start task

From the repository root run `./agentflow start $ARGUMENTS` on POSIX or `.\agentflow.ps1 start $ARGUMENTS` on Windows. This invokes fresh product, architecture, development, QA, and review stages. Do not bypass verification or push/merge afterward.
